digest: Prioritize stop-signal lifecycle races, cancellation classification, and terminal-status precedence; integration evidence is absent from this excerpt.

reviewLenses.focus: Runtime correctness of launch fencing, polling, and disposal
reviewLenses.whyNeeded: Cancellation combines shared registrations, asynchronous persistence reads, and interval polling; races or read failures could delay or lose stop propagation.

reviewLenses.focus: Provider cancellation recognition and error-contract precision
reviewLenses.whyNeeded: Cancellation markers are accepted across several object shapes and recursively parsed provider text; false positives can suppress failures, while missing supported shapes can defeat cancellation handling.

reviewLenses.focus: Preservation of interrupted and failed outcomes in dynamic summaries
reviewLenses.whyNeeded: Every terminal direct-dynamic run receives a semantic-status override based on controller artifacts, potentially obscuring cancellation or failure with stale or missing output.

triageSummary: Three small modules warrant three bounded correctness lenses, not broad security or architecture fanout. Highest-risk questions are whether stop propagation survives asynchronous lifecycle races and whether dynamic summaries preserve interruption/failure. This repository explicitly omits store.js and types.js and supplies no callers, provider adapters, or tests, so persistence guarantees, real provider contracts, and end-to-end behavior remain unverified. Review must stay within this excerpt.
skippedLenses: Dedicated security audit: no authentication, authorization, or process-execution boundary is present; classifier robustness remains in correctness scope.
Dedicated release/test hygiene: no tests or integration dependencies are supplied; reviewers should identify focused reproductions without claiming executed coverage.
Migration/compatibility audit: no diff or removed public exception is supplied; provider-shape compatibility is covered by the classification lens.
